Definition: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
BiblicalUsage: 1) lip, language, speech, shore, bank, brink, brim, side, edge, border, binding; 1a) lip (as body part); 1b) language; 1c) edge, shore, bank (of cup, sea, river, etc)
